== Course of events ==

The event took place after Ozma's party had crossed the desert on the magic carpet and reached the Emerald City, and after Ozma herself had been welcomed home with a grand reception in which she honored her officers and companions with gifts. Amid this return to order, attention turned to the royal house of Ev: the Queen's eldest son, Evardo, was crowned King Evardo Fifteenth of Ev in a public ceremony.

The coronation established Evardo as King Evardo Fifteenth of Ev. It was followed by the joyful reunion of the Tin Woodman with the Scarecrow and Tiktok, after which the group returned together to the royal palace of Ev.
